title: Plot ID alphabet is lowercase alphanumeric, not strict base32
rationale: SPEC §3.3 says 'pl-<8 char base32>', but the example 'pl-abc12345' contains '1' which is not a valid RFC 4648 base32 character. We interpret the spec as lowercase alphanumeric [a-z0-9]{8}. Tightening to strict base32 later would reject previously-valid IDs, so the looser pattern is locked in for V1.

content: Use 'as string[]' on both sides of expect(...).toEqual(...) when comparing readonly const-tuple arrays (e.g. spread of 'as const' tuples). Without the cast, bun:test's toEqual narrows the expected param to the literal-union element type and fails typecheck even though the runtime values are equal.

title: Plot ID prefix is plot- (not pl-) to disambiguate from seeds plan IDs
rationale: Seeds plan IDs (pl-<4 hex>) and Plot IDs (pl-<8 alnum>) collide on prefix when both appear in an agent context. Renamed Plot prefix to plot- (now plot-<8 lowercase alphanumeric>). Plot was v0.1.1 with a single Plot in existence, smaller blast radius than renaming seeds. pt- considered and rejected as cryptic — IDs aren't hand-typed often. The rename is breaking: old pl-<8> IDs are rejected by isPlotId/assertPlotId and the JSON schema.
